lines.cap: This is Sam. He's the best plumber in town. But his phone is quiet.
When a customer has a leak, she doesn't call Sam. She asks Google, Maps or ChatGPT: who should I call?
Every engine decides the same way. It asks three things.
Can I read what this business does? Do other sources confirm it? Do real people choose it?
The three multiply. If one is zero, the answer is zero. So the engine names someone else.
We fix all three. Read: Sam's site now says plainly what he does, where, and for whom.
Confirm: listings, reviews and mentions that say the same thing.
Choose: a listing people pick, and calls that prove it.
Same question. Now every engine has a reason to name Sam.
That is the D'Souza Equation. Relevance = Read × Confirm × Choose. Be the answer.
